Recursive functions

Source: R/functions.R
z3_rec_function.Rd

z3_rec_function() declares a function whose definition may refer to itself. Define it with z3_rec_define(f, args, body), where args are constants standing for the parameters. Z3 unfolds the definition on demand during solving.

Usage

z3_rec_function(ctx, name, domain, range)

z3_rec_define(f, args, body)

Arguments

ctx

A z3_context().

name

Name of the function.

domain

A sort or a list of argument sorts.

range

Result sort.

f

A function from z3_rec_function().

args

A constant or list of constants, one per argument.

body

The function body.

Value

z3_rec_function() returns a z3_function; z3_rec_define() returns f invisibly.

Examples

ctx <- z3_context()
I <- z3_int_sort(ctx)
fact <- z3_rec_function(ctx, "fact", I, I)
n <- z3_int(ctx, "n")
z3_rec_define(fact, n, z3_ite(n <= 0, 1, n * fact(n - 1)))
s <- z3_solver(ctx)
x <- z3_int(ctx, "x")
z3_add(s, fact(x) == 120)
z3_check(s)
#> [1] "sat"
z3_eval(z3_model(s), x)
#> <z3_expr Int> 5
